THEORY

PROCESS

Take a glass tube and bend near to the one end at acute angle. Bend the another end of the tube at acute angle just in opposite direction of first bending. Put some granulated zinc pieces in the woulfts bottle and fit the apparatus as shown in figure. Check the airtightness of the apparatus. Pour a little water slowly from the wash bottle into the thistle funnel to test the airtighmess of the apparatus. If the apparatus is airtight, water will not fall down into woulfts bottle. Throw out this water into the sink without retnoving finger from the delivery tube. Pour dilute sulphuric acid through the thistle funnel into the woulfs bottle. Collect the produced gas by the action of zinc and dilute sulphuric acid by downward displacement of water. Study its properües by performing following experiments.
